CREATE SCHEMA cssql_oracle;
CREATE TABLE cssql_oracle.analytics_combined_frames
  (source_id serial PRIMARY KEY, region text, slot integer NOT NULL, tenant text NOT NULL, included boolean NOT NULL, amount double precision);
INSERT INTO cssql_oracle.analytics_combined_frames(region,slot,tenant,included,amount) VALUES
  ('A',1,'A',true,10),('A',1,'A',true,20),('A',2,'A',true,NULL),('A',3,'A',true,0),('A',4,'A',true,-5),('A',5,'A',true,25),
  ('B',1,'A',true,100),('B',2,'A',true,NULL),('B',3,'A',true,200),('B',4,'A',true,-300),('B',5,'A',true,NULL),
  ('C',1,'A',true,NULL),('C',2,'A',true,NULL),
  (NULL,1,'A',true,7),(NULL,2,'A',true,NULL),(NULL,3,'A',true,9),
  ('',1,'A',true,50),('',2,'A',true,NULL),('',3,'A',true,-50),
  ('A',1,'B',true,10000),('A',6,'B',true,20000),('foreign',1,'B',true,40000),
  ('A',1,'A',false,900000);

cases.sql:
WITH base AS (
SELECT
  analytics_combined_frames.region AS "analytics_combined_frames.region", analytics_combined_frames.slot AS "analytics_combined_frames.slot", MEASURE(analytics_combined_frames.total) AS "base"
  FROM analytics_combined_frames
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
scope AS (
SELECT
  MEASURE(analytics_combined_frames.total) AS "grand"
  FROM analytics_combined_frames
),
combined AS (
SELECT
  base."analytics_combined_frames.region" AS "analytics_combined_frames.region", base."analytics_combined_frames.slot" AS "analytics_combined_frames.slot", base."base" AS "base", scope."grand" AS "grand"
  FROM base CROSS JOIN scope
),
windowed AS (
SELECT
  combined."analytics_combined_frames.region" AS "analytics_combined_frames.region", combined."analytics_combined_frames.slot" AS "analytics_combined_frames.slot", combined."base" AS "base", combined."grand" AS "grand", SUM(combined."base") OVER (PARTITION BY combined."analytics_combined_frames.region" ORDER BY combined."analytics_combined_frames.slot" ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS "window", CAST(RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY combined."analytics_combined_frames.region" ORDER BY combined."analytics_combined_frames.slot" DESC) AS BIGINT) AS "position"
  FROM combined
)
SELECT
  windowed."analytics_combined_frames.region" AS "analytics_combined_frames.region", windowed."analytics_combined_frames.slot" AS "analytics_combined_frames.slot", windowed."window" AS "window", windowed."position" AS "position", windowed."grand" AS "grand", ((CAST(windowed."window" AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) / NULLIF(windowed."grand", 0)) AS "share"
  FROM windowed
  ORDER BY "analytics_combined_frames.slot"
  LIMIT 100
cases.analystOracle:
WITH authorized AS (SELECT * FROM cssql_oracle.analytics_combined_frames WHERE included = true AND tenant='A'),
    grouped AS (SELECT region,slot,SUM(amount) AS value FROM authorized GROUP BY region,slot),
    evaluated AS (SELECT region AS "analytics_combined_frames.region",slot AS "analytics_combined_frames.slot",
      CASE WHEN COUNT(value) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY slot ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) >= 0 THEN SUM(value) OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY slot ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) ELSE NULL END AS "window",
      RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY slot DESC)::bigint AS position,
      (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM authorized) AS grand FROM grouped)
    SELECT *, "window" / NULLIF(grand,0) AS share FROM evaluated ORDER BY "analytics_combined_frames.slot"
